description: Dept. of Labour -  Special Allowance payable to the workers in Cocoa, Cardamom, & Pepper Growing & Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers based on the Cost of Living Index Number, issued under Section 20(2)(b) of the Wages Boards Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter concerning wage adjustments and falls under the Legal/Regulatory category (Type 5) as it involves the implementation of provisions from existing legislation (the Wages Boards Ordinance) to regulate employment conditions in a specific trade.
